title: eng-hiring-onboarding-weekly-sync-2026-02-28
content:
Weekly sync notes: Hiring, onboarding, and team health - platform engineering
Date: 2026-02-28
Owner: Asha Patel
Attendees: Asha (owner), Daniel K., Maya A., Jordan L., Priya S. (recruiter), plus notes from 1:1s captured separately

Agenda:
- Interview debriefs (infra/backend, runtime, SRE candidates)
- Onboarding status for recent hires + buddy check-ins
- Team health signals and 1:1 themes
- Hiring metrics and pipeline updates
- Action items and blockers

1) Interview debriefs
- Candidate: Backend Infra Engineer (REQ-PE-045)
  - Interviewers: Daniel, Maya, hiring manager: Jordan
  - Summary: Strong systems design and distributed systems experience; good on storage/sharding patterns; weaker on performance debugging (didn't use flamegraphs initially).
  - Score: Recommend (4/5)
  - Next step: Offer (comp) discussion with People Ops; Priya to confirm comp band; target decision by 2026-03-04.
  - Notes: Need to calibrate on on-call expectations in offer letter (hours, rotation cadence).

- Candidate: Inference Runtime Engineer (REQ-PE-052)
  - Interviewers: Asha, Jordan, external contractor (runtime tech lead)
  - Summary: Excellent attention to kernel-level optimizations and CUDA familiarity; has shipping experience on quantized kernels. Cultural fit uneven — prefers individual contributor deep work over cross-team collaboration.
  - Score: Hold/consider (3/5)
  - Next step: Send follow-up behavioral interview focused on cross-team collaboration; schedule week of 2026-03-02.

- Candidate: Site Reliability Engineer (REQ-SRE-018)
  - Interviewers: Maya, Daniel, SRE lead (Luis)
  - Summary: Strong incident response background, good runbooks examples, proactive monitoring ideas. Lacks Rust experience but comfortable with Go/Python.
  - Score: Recommend (4/5)
  - Next step: Proceed to final manager loop; Priya to confirm reference checks.

Recruiter notes: Priya reports pipeline is healthy for infra and SRE but thin for senior runtime candidates. Consider contractor-to-hire options for runtime short-term coverage.

2) Onboarding sync (new hires + buddy program)
- New hire: Elena Gomez (Platform Engineer) — start 2026-02-15
  - Current: completed week 2 onboarding checklist; paired with buddy Daniel for runtime deep-dive; blocker: IAM access to private model test clusters (ticket raised to infra, ETA 2026-03-01).
  - Action: Jordan to escalate cluster access ticket in infra standup (JIRA-OPS-332).

- New hire: Omar Hassan (SRE) — start 2026-02-22
  - Current: shadowed on-call rotations twice; added to PagerDuty; needs permissions for metrics dashboards (Grafana) and runbook ownership assigned.
  - Action: Maya to add runbook ownership and share runbook review schedule (due 2026-03-05).

- Onboarding notes: Buddy check-ins happening twice/week; feedback: new hires want more hands-on infra lab exercises for private deployment workflows. Suggested: create 2-3 short lab exercises (deploy a simple model, debug KV cache miss) — owner: Daniel, due 2026-03-12.

3) Team health signals / 1:1 themes
- Common themes from 1:1s this week: onboarding friction (access/permissions), clarity on career ladders for infra/runtime tracks, burnout risk on small subteam owning both Dedicated and Private rollout tasks.
- Action: Quick pulse survey to platform-eng (3 questions) — Asha will run the short survey in Slack, post by 2026-03-02, deadline 2026-03-06.
- Manager follow-ups: schedule skip-levels with product-owner and two ICs on Dedicated rollout (Asha/Jordan) — target week of 2026-03-09.

4) Hiring metrics snapshot (as of 2026-02-28)
- Open reqs: 7 (Platform infra: 2, Runtime: 2, SRE: 3)
- Time-to-offer (median): 34 days
- Offer acceptance rate (last 90 days): 68%
- Interview-to-offer ratio: ~6:1
- Notes: Need to shorten cycles for runtime candidates — aim to reduce median to 21 days by end of Q2 through faster scheduling and clearer job spec updates.

5) Blockers and risks
- Access delays for new hires (cluster/Grafana) impacting ramp — infra backlog high due to Dedicated rollout; escalate if not resolved within 5 business days.
- Senior runtime candidate scarcity — consider sourcing via partner contractor firms and increase referral bonus for runtime roles temporarily.
- On-call load concentrated on small subteam — plan temporary rotation adjustment or hire contractor for Q2.

6) Action items (owner, due)
- Priya: confirm comp bands and move Backend Infra candidate to offer discussion (due 2026-03-04).
- Jordan: escalate IAM/cluster access ticket (JIRA-OPS-332) and update status in next infra standup (due 2026-03-01).
- Maya: assign runbook ownership for Omar and schedule review (due 2026-03-05).
- Daniel: create 2 onboarding lab exercises for private deployment workflows (due 2026-03-12).
- Asha: run 3-question team pulse survey in Slack and share results (post by 2026-03-02, collate by 2026-03-06).
- Recruiting/Pipeline: Priya to source 3 contractor leads for runtime work and share candidates (due 2026-03-08).

Notes & references:
- See Confluence hiring tracker: CONFLUENCE-ENG-1294 for full candidate notes and scorecards.
- Candidate scorecards linked in JIRA tickets: JIRA-ENG-4567 and REQ-specific pages.
- Related PR: github.com/redwood-inference/eng-onboarding/pull/88 (onboarding lab framework initial commit).

Next sync: 2026-03-07 (weekly), same time.

End of doc.
